build_300wlp_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow Dataset Builder for the 300W-LP face landmark dataset with images and 68-point landmarks
create_builder_info: create dataset info with image features and 68-point 2D/3D landmark tensors plus pose, shape, and illumination parameters
run_split_generators: run split generators to download and extract the 300W-LP dataset from Google Drive and configure the train split
generate_dataset_examples: generate dataset examples by reading JPEG images and MATLAB landmark files to yield records with images and facial parameters
review_builder_class: review the Builder class that extends GeneratorBasedBuilder for the 300W-LP face alignment dataset
